summary: Underfunded schools in impoverished developing countries benefit from CodiTeach, a royalty-free educational platform that streamlines account management for teachers, classes, and students. This platform addresses the educational needs of underprivileged communities, particularly in low-income countries. By providing a cost-effective alternative to expensive educational platforms, CodiTeach aims to improve access to quality education for disadvantaged students. The platform's features include role-based access control, class management, and comprehensive curricular access, which enhance the learning experience for students. CodiTeach operates in the education sector, focusing on improving educational outcomes and promoting digital inclusion in developing regions.
